facts.text: Aeten II, also simply known as Aeten, was a volcanically turbulent planet located in Wild Space in grid square J-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
entities: Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game

evidence.quote: Aeten II, also simply known as Aeten, was a volcanically turbulent planet located in Wild Space in grid square J-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

facts.text: During the era of the Galactic Republic, scientists discovered the existence of stygium crystals on Aeten II, which proved previously theoretical designs for a cloaking device as feasible.

evidence.quote: During the era of the Galactic Republic, scientists discovered the existence of stygium crystals on Aeten II, which proved previously theoretical designs for a cloaking device as feasible.

facts.text: In the new Star Wars canon, Aeten II was first mentioned as "Aeten" in Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game, published by Fantasy Flight Games in 2016.
entities: Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game

evidence.quote: In the new Star Wars canon, Aeten II was first mentioned as "Aeten" in Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game, published by Fantasy Flight Games in 2016.

facts.text: Its entire name was later given in the reference book TIE Fighter Owners' Workshop Manual, written by Ryder Windham and released in 2019.

evidence.quote: Its entire name was later given in the reference book TIE Fighter Owners' Workshop Manual, written by Ryder Windham and released in 2019.

facts.text: While The Force Awakens Beginner Game places Aeten II in Wild Space, TIE Fighter Owners' Workshop Manual and Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition states its location as the Outer Rim Territories.
entities: Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition
Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition

evidence.quote: While The Force Awakens Beginner Game places Aeten II in Wild Space, TIE Fighter Owners' Workshop Manual and Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition states its location as the Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: The planet was destroyed in 3 ABY, shortly following the Battle of Hoth, by Imperial Grand Admiral Martio Batch, using the Tarkin superweapon.

evidence.quote: The planet was destroyed in 3 ABY, shortly following the Battle of Hoth, by Imperial Grand Admiral Martio Batch, using the Tarkin superweapon.

facts.text: During the time of the Cold War between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, the planet Aeten II, located in Wild Space, was represented in the Rift Alliance by the Sullustan Diab Duin.

evidence.quote: During the time of the Cold War between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, the planet Aeten II, located in Wild Space, was represented in the Rift Alliance by the Sullustan Diab Duin.

facts.text: The Sith Empire established a space station in the planet's orbit.

evidence.quote: The Sith Empire established a space station in the planet's orbit.

facts.text: Near the end of the Cold War, two Imperial traitors infiltrated the Sith Empire's space station and disabled its defenses.

evidence.quote: Near the end of the Cold War, two Imperial traitors infiltrated the Sith Empire's space station and disabled its defenses.

facts.text: The agents were eventually neutralized, though their efforts left the station defenseless; this allowed a Republic fleet to attack and capture the station.

evidence.quote: The agents were eventually neutralized, though their efforts left the station defenseless; this allowed a Republic fleet to attack and capture the station.

facts.text: Aeten II was later settled by the Galactic Republic, circa 1000 BBY.

evidence.quote: Aeten II was later settled by the Galactic Republic, circa 1000 BBY.

facts.text: Eventually, the new inhabitants discovered the vast resources of stygium within the planet and rapidly built mines to extract the valuable mineral.

evidence.quote: Eventually, the new inhabitants discovered the vast resources of stygium within the planet and rapidly built mines to extract the valuable mineral.

facts.text: During the last year of the Clone Wars, Aeten II was the site of the month-long Battle of Dreighton.

evidence.quote: During the last year of the Clone Wars, Aeten II was the site of the month-long Battle of Dreighton.

facts.text: Both the Galactic Republic, aided by the Pendarran Warriors, and the Confederacy of Independent Systems wished to capture the planet so that they could gain a significant advantage in the use of cloaking technology.

evidence.quote: Both the Galactic Republic, aided by the Pendarran Warriors, and the Confederacy of Independent Systems wished to capture the planet so that they could gain a significant advantage in the use of cloaking technology.

facts.text: Once the two factions attacked one another, however, Hutt and Black Sun forces entered the system and destroyed the remainders of all three fleets.

evidence.quote: Once the two factions attacked one another, however, Hutt and Black Sun forces entered the system and destroyed the remainders of all three fleets.

facts.text: The aftermath of the battle also had many rumors about the nebula being haunted afterwards with ghost ships and the dead pilots of the battle, giving birth to the idea of the Dreighton Triangle.

evidence.quote: The aftermath of the battle also had many rumors about the nebula being haunted afterwards with ghost ships and the dead pilots of the battle, giving birth to the idea of the Dreighton Triangle.

facts.text: It was in orbit of the ruins of Aeten II that the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Terror, under Admiral Sarn, protected the crystal supply.

evidence.quote: It was in orbit of the ruins of Aeten II that the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Terror, under Admiral Sarn, protected the crystal supply.

facts.text: His plan eventually failed when Rebel saboteurs Rookie One and Ru Murleen destroyed the Terror, the corresponding TIE Phantom factory on Imdaar Alpha and all the TIE Phantoms.

evidence.quote: His plan eventually failed when Rebel saboteurs Rookie One and Ru Murleen destroyed the Terror, the corresponding TIE Phantom factory on Imdaar Alpha and all the TIE Phantoms.

facts.text: Aeten II is present in the Empire at War story campaign, but not in the Forces of Corruption story campaign.

evidence.quote: Aeten II is present in the Empire at War story campaign, but not in the Forces of Corruption story campaign.

facts.text: This is consistent with the planet's destruction by the Tarkin superweapon after the Battle of Yavin.

evidence.quote: This is consistent with the planet's destruction by the Tarkin superweapon after the Battle of Yavin.

facts.text: However, the planet appears in Forces of Corruption's galactic conquest mode unchanged, which is acceptable because this game mode is not meant to be taken as canon.

evidence.quote: However, the planet appears in Forces of Corruption's galactic conquest mode unchanged, which is acceptable because this game mode is not meant to be taken as canon.

facts.text: The Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide and The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia incorrectly place Aeten II in the Outer Rim Territories.
entities: Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide

evidence.quote: The Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide and The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia incorrectly place Aeten II in the Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: The Essential Atlas has eventually stated that the system is in Wild Space.

evidence.quote: The Essential Atlas has eventually stated that the system is in Wild Space.

facts.text: Some of the mission text for the Aeten Defense space mission in Star Wars: The Old Republic mistakenly refers to the planet as Aeten Ten, while other instances in the text files correctly name it as Aeten II.

evidence.quote: Some of the mission text for the Aeten Defense space mission in Star Wars: The Old Republic mistakenly refers to the planet as Aeten Ten, while other instances in the text files correctly name it as Aeten II.

facts.text: Early on in the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, Republic agents aboard the space station Kilran's Lance above Aeten II disabled the station's defenses and a Republic fleet attacked the station.

evidence.quote: Early on in the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, Republic agents aboard the space station Kilran's Lance above Aeten II disabled the station's defenses and a Republic fleet attacked the station.
